status: Unsigned cross-platform baseline; macOS is non-notarized

checks.focusedTests: 12 targeted checks pass; production build passes.
checks.encoder: Real older HEVC source produced complete HLS segments with VideoToolbox and libx264; cached scene thumbnail decoded.
checks.installation: Mounted DMG, matching packaged backend/frontend bytes, installed arm64 bundle and ready 0.11.0 service verified.
checks.live: Installed app: older HEVC transcoding and compatible H.264 Direct Play; exact paused position/rate/track preservation, playing and rapid quality changes; decoded desktop and touch timeline previews; PiP/Home retained one page; partial/completed history; two login identities and exact Chrome revocation confirmed.
checks.responsive: Phone 390×844 and tablet 820×1180 viewport/touch emulation inspected, selection remained empty, no horizontal overflow; overrides restored.

installedApplicationChecks: NSIS installer installs the branded x64 app, host and runtime without elevation
Windows per-user background host and Jellyfin become healthy
Native administration signs in, renders the shared dark UI, and closing it leaves playback server running
Real scanner indexes Windows Unicode/space paths with original files unchanged
Supported video uses actual Direct Play in Windows Edge
Legacy video actually transcodes to HLS; quality changes preserve paused position
Timeline cache extracts and displays a real Windows FFmpeg scene preview
Profile Watch History is connected to actual Windows playback reports
Music playback and the original branded disc render on Windows
Clean stop/start and Windows tar backup/restore preflight work
Unexpected worker termination is reaped and restarted by the Windows host
Tray-host stop and reopening restart the same preserved library profile
In-place NSIS upgrade preserves configuration, database and sign-in startup choice
Uninstaller removes app and startup registration while preserving user data and original media
Disposable Windows test user/profile/media removed from runner; installer contains no seeded account
windows.ui: Native Administration, video controls/preview and branded-disc music screenshots visually inspected.

limitations: Unsigned Apple silicon macOS 14+ artifact; no Intel Mac qualification.
Physical Android phone/tablet behavior requires device validation.
Native HLS may contain one rendition; no CPU-heavy pre-encoded ladder is manufactured.
Hardware failure recovery through configuration requires an authenticated administrator connection.
Existing history imports the latest reliable engine viewing timestamp per title; older unrecorded rewatches cannot be reconstructed.
Phone/tablet checks used Chrome emulation, not physical Android devices.
Forced hardware-encoder failure and actual network-loss recovery were not live-injected; software encoding and transaction rollback were checked separately.
Logout/expiry/offline and cross-user history protection use focused server fixtures; live revocation used two logins of one existing account.
Hosted Windows Server runner; physical consumer GPU, HDR/DRM and signed-installer SmartScreen reputation are not qualified.
No public Cloudflare tunnel was configured by CI.
